C. Louisa's action intended to harm Henry, and thus fails to meet the condition of benefiting someone other than the agent. Therefore, it does not conform to the principle.

D. Yolanda's action achieved her intended goal (her children enjoying their vacation) and also benefited Henry (the grandfather). This meets both conditions of the philosopher's principle.

Option D is the only one that fully conforms to the given principle.</think>
